purpose: Single source of truth for the wording of the five hero surfaces. qa/core-tests.mjs fails when a surface diverges from this file. To change settled wording, change the page AND this registry in the same commit. Differences listed in intentional_differences are deliberate and must never be flagged.

facts.privacy_sentence_en: The draw is picked in your browser. To make the private links work, the names and matches are stored on our server, in a form we can read.
facts.recipient_interests: Optional: a person can tap what they're into (or surprise-me) on their own link page. Those picks are stored under their link code and shown only to the person who drew them, on that person's own link. The organizer sees only that a person added something, never what. Nobody else's link returns them.

secrecy_guardrail.purpose: Unscoped secrecy claims (Billy, Nov 20, 2026): wording that reads as if matches were secret from everyone including the site operator, who can in fact read the store. The flat forbidden_strings list is a whole-file ban and cannot hold the grandfathered occurrences below, so this family lives here as a census: qa/core-tests.mjs counts the patterns in every in-scope file and fails unless the counts match this census exactly. A NEW unscoped claim fails the suite; removing a grandfathered one requires updating the census in the same commit. The patterns are claim phrases only — the game names (Secret Santa, amigo secreto) can never match: 'in secret' carries a negative lookahead for ' Santa'. 'kept secret' and bare 'secret from' are deliberately NOT patterns: their only site-wide occurrences are the slips.js honesty comment ('nothing here claims a slip can be... kept secret from the organizer'), which negates the claim. Grandfathered occurrences are inventoried and classified in ~/workspace/builds/santa-secret-claim-2026-11-20/REPORT.md. The category-(iii) items were DECIDED by Billy on Nov 20, 2026 ('language everywhere' + his explicit go-ahead) and fixed the same day (report: ~/workspace/builds/santa-secret-claim-fixes-2026-11-20/REPORT.md); the census above reflects the post-fix counts. Remaining grandfathered occurrences are category (i)/(ii) plus the held-by-rule residue: everything inside <title> tags (including the ES/PT pack homepage title strings) and /draw-names-online's HowTo + FAQ JSON-LD (post-crest schema hold).

no wish lists, no anonymous questions

blind_rework.reason: Billy: the shipped page read as the home team grading its rivals; reworked so the grading is blind and the page reads as reporting.
blind_rework.method: Rubric fixed before scoring (7 criteria, 0-5 each, equal weight, total 35). The seven tools were rewritten as anonymized profiles (names, brands, URLs stripped; labels Tool A-G, randomized) built from the same evidence table. Profiles scored by a cold GPT-4o run (OpenAI API) that was not told which profile was which; names attached only after scores were final.
blind_rework.santa_placement: third of seven, 25 of 35; per-criterion: nothing demanded 5, organizer plays blind 3, reveal privacy 4, handoff effort 5, group size 2, extras 1, ads 5
blind_rework.page_states: Authorship disclosed on the page ('Published by Pick My Secret Santa. That is exactly why Pick My Secret Santa did not grade it.'); full scores and the judge's verbatim reasons published; Santa's drawbacks box kept at full strength.
